description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §10.5 (v1.4) DELETE /v1/subjects/{id} success: hard-deletes the subject's time-series payload, tombstones the subject + its sessions, retains consent + audit, and returns 200 with status 'erased' and the subjects.erased proof-row id as audit_entry_id. The tenant is taken from the authenticated session context, never the request. SHAPE vector.
notes: erased_at is the server-set subjects.deleted_at; audit_entry_id is the subjects.erased proof row returned as the erasure proof (CS §10.5 v1.4 / Group 10 Option A).

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §10.5 (v1.4) idempotent re-erasure: DELETE on an already-tombstoned subject returns 200 with status 'already_erased' and NO audit_entry_id (no new proof row) — deliberately not 404 and not 204. SHAPE vector.
notes: Idempotent: no new proof row is written on re-erasure (CS §10.5 v1.4).
